artwork_provenance.repository_license: MIT; exact pinned notice included in LICENSE
artwork_provenance.artwork_origin_as_stated_upstream: Cleaned vector artwork from an archived SWF on the official The Matrix: Path of Neo promotional website. Upstream describes katakana-derived forms and characters from Susan Kare's Chicago typeface.
artwork_provenance.rights_scope: The repository MIT notice is preserved as published. It is not a separate clearance or assertion of ownership of every underlying film or typeface element.

transformation.coordinate_method: exact Decimal translation of each 64x64 cell, then uniform 100/64 scaling
transformation.curves: Cubic Bezier geometry retained; relative and shorthand commands expanded exactly
transformation.closure: Implicit fill closures serialized explicitly; nonzero winding retained
transformation.inspection_png: 4x antialiasing; adaptive cubic sampling at 0.01 normalized-unit tolerance

artwork_provenance.original_generated_catalog: The separate 192 original SVG catalog is unchanged and is not part of this import.

cyber_catalog: Reuses assets/cyber-glyphs.json; all 192 SVG hashes and contours match the pinned Noumenon catalog. Its license is embedded in that file.
port: CPU float64 analytic Classic state at 60 Hz; contour raster mipmaps; linear-light scene composition. WebGL half-float and MSDF pixel parity is not claimed.
